records.title: Advances and Challenges in Foundation Agents: From Brain-Inspired Intelligence to Evolutionary, Collaborative, and Safe Systems
records.reason: The survey covers agent architectures and workflows broadly; it is not a primary system result and does not present a concrete inference-cost improvement for the linked efficient-reasoning lineage.

records.title: RynnVLA-002: A Unified Vision-Language-Action and World Model
records.reason: RynnVLA-002 is a vision-language-action/world-model capability paper with no LLM serving-efficiency contribution.

records.title: ShinkaEvolve: Towards Open-Ended And Sample-Efficient Program Evolution
records.reason: ShinkaEvolve optimizes program-evolution search/sample efficiency using LLM ensembles and novelty checks; its primary text does not show LLM inference/runtime kernel gains despite the kernel-compilation lineage link.

records.title: Hardware Approximate Techniques for Deep Neural Network Accelerators: A Survey
records.reason: The paper surveys approximate DNN accelerator techniques, a broad hardware topic; no LLM-specific design or measured LLM serving result is identified.

records.title: Beyond Ten Turns: Unlocking Long-Horizon Agentic Search with Large-Scale Asynchronous RL
records.reason: The method improves asynchronous agentic-RL training utilization, not online inference service; relevance is limited to the training/rollout boundary of an agentic inference system.
